Container.Name: novacortex-surrealdb
Container.Overview:
SurrealDB preconfigured as the primary datastore for the NovaCortex stack — memories, relations, the knowledge base and API tokens all live here. SurrealDB itself is by SurrealDB Ltd; this template is maintained by Nova Cognitive Systems, and support below goes to the NovaCortex issue tracker.
Part 2 of a 5-container stack. Install in this order, all on the same Docker network:
0. Create the shared network once, from an Unraid terminal: docker network create novacortex Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network, which is how the API finds this container by the name "novacortex-surrealdb". 1. novacortex-redis 2. novacortex-surrealdb (this template) 3. novacortex-qdrant 4. novacortex-api 5. novacortex-web
Prefer one click to five? Install the whole stack with the Docker Compose Manager plugin instead — see templates/unraid/README.md in the project repository. Both paths are supported and produce the same container names.
Notes for this container: - It publishes no ports. Only containers on the novacortex network reach it, which is what you want for a database holding your agent's memory. - It runs as root on purpose (Extra Parameters: --user 0:0). The image defaults to uid 65532, but Unraid appdata bind mounts are root-owned and data written by NovaCortex before v1.3 is root-owned too, so RocksDB fails with "Permission denied" without this. - Keep the password you set here; the novacortex-api template needs the same value.
Container.Description:
SurrealDB is a multi-model database (document, graph and relational in one engine) with a single binary and no external dependencies. NovaCortex uses it as the system of record: typed memories, the relation graph between them, knowledge-base documents, namespaces and API tokens. Storage is RocksDB on a local path, so everything stays on your server.
This template pins v2.2, the version the NovaCortex stack is tested against, and stores its data under /mnt/user/appdata/novacortex/surrealdb.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex). Only useful together with the rest of the NovaCortex stack.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: novacortex surrealdb database graph memory mcp self-hosted agents

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Where SurrealDB keeps its RocksDB store. Must be an absolute path on the array or a pool — never the boot flash.

Config.Name: Root Username
Config.Description: Root username, created on first start. The novacortex-api template must use the same value for SURREALDB_USER.

Config.Name: Root Password
Config.Description: Root password, set on first start. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24 — and use the identical value for SURREALDB_PASS in the novacortex-api template.

Config.Name: Storage Path (engine URI)
Config.Description: Storage engine and location inside the container. Leave as-is unless you know why you are changing it — 'memory' would discard every memory on restart.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of: none, error, warn, info, debug, trace.
